Ferrari ended Mercedes' winning run in Barcelona, while the weekend's qualifying evidence showed Russell on pole, Hamilton only 0.064 seconds back, and Antonelli third after reporting difficulty with the car. Antonelli remains the Austrian favorite given five recent wins and Mercedes' season strength, but 0.64 was too concentrated for a single race.

Saudi Arabia's final warm-up used a strong first-half side and produced direct chances for Musab Al Juwayr after a Salem Al Dawsari pass and for Mohammed Abu Al Shamat from a close-range header. Abu Al Shamat replaces the less-evidenced Sultan Mandash, while Salem remains the talisman and favorite.

Lamine Camara generated Senegal's clearest early warm-up effort with a headed attempt, so he replaces Bamba Dieng on the five-player slate. Mane remains first but is reduced from 0.45 to avoid the striker-heavy overconcentration exposed by today's Ayari and Van Dijk resolutions.
